title: Auto-Encoders for Recommendations: Deep Learning for Recs

cues.en: We mentioned that restrictive Boltzmann machines were a very early type of neural network, and the field of deep learning has evolved considerably since then.
cues.zh: 前面提過，受限玻爾茲曼機是很早期的神經網路，深度學習之後已發展很多。

cues.en: What happens if we apply a more contemporary neural network to the problem?
cues.zh: 如果用較現代神經網路，解決這個問題呢？

cues.en: Well, as we'll see, it possible, but not without its challenges.
cues.zh: 稍後會看到，可以，但有挑戰。

cues.en: People started using deeper neural networks for recommender systems in 2015, which seems pretty recent, but it's a long time in the context of current AI research.
cues.zh: 2015 年，人們開始用更深神經網路做推薦，看似近期，但在當前 AI 研究脈絡，已很久。

cues.en: A group from the Australian National University published a paper called AutoRec: Autoencoders Meet Collaborative Filtering, and they used the topology you see here.
cues.zh: 澳洲國立大學團隊，發表 AutoRec: Autoencoders Meet Collaborative Filtering，使用這個拓樸。

cues.en: It looks a lot more familiar to the sorts of networks we covered in our introduction to deep learning.
cues.zh: 比較像深度學習入門中，介紹的網路。

cues.en: You have three layers: an input layer on the bottom that contains individual ratings, a hidden layer, and an output layer that gives us our predictions.
cues.zh: 三層：底部是包含個別評分的輸入層，中間隱藏層，最上是預測輸出層。

cues.en: A matrix of weights between the layers is maintained across every instance of this network, as well as a bias node for both the hidden and output layers.
cues.zh: 各個網路實例共用層間權重矩陣，隱藏與輸出層也各有偏差節點。

cues.en: In the paper, they trained the network once per item, feeding in ratings from each user for that item in the input layer.
cues.zh: 論文中，每個項目訓練一次，輸入層放各使用者對該項目的評分。

cues.en: A sigmoid activation function was used on the output.
cues.zh: 輸出使用 Sigmoid。

cues.en: All in all, it's a pretty straightforward approach, and they reported slightly better results compared to using an RBM.
cues.zh: 整體相當直接，回報結果略優於 RBM。

cues.en: But the implementation is a bit different.
cues.zh: 但實作有些不同。

cues.en: RBMs just had separate bias turns for each pass, while here, we have a whole separate set of weights to work with, too.
cues.zh: RBM 只是前向、反向各有偏差，這裡則連權重也各自一組。

cues.en: This sort of architecture also has the benefit of being a lot easier to implement in modern frameworks such as tensorflow or keras.
cues.zh: 這種架構也更容易，在 TensorFlow 或 Keras 等現代框架實作。

cues.en: But there's still one wrinkle: the sparsity of the data we are working with.
cues.zh: 但仍有一個難題：資料稀疏。

cues.en: In the paper, they briefly mention that "we only consider the contribution of observed ratings."
cues.zh: 論文簡短提到：「只考慮觀察到的評分貢獻。」

cues.en: So, they were careful to process each path through this neural network individually, only propagating information from ratings that actually exist in the training data and ignoring the contribution from input nodes
cues.zh: 因此，他們仔細處理網路每條路徑，只傳播實際存在評分的資訊，忽略

cues.en: that correspond to missing data from user item pairs that weren't rated at all.
cues.zh: 沒有評分的使用者／項目配對，所對應缺失資料輸入節點的貢獻。

cues.en: This is still a tough thing to do in tensorflow.
cues.zh: TensorFlow 仍很難做。

cues.en: While tensorflow does have sparse tensors, there's no simple way to restrict the chain of matrix multiplications and additions needed to implement a neural network to just the input nodes with actual data in them.
cues.zh: 雖然有稀疏張量，但沒有簡單方法，將神經網路所需的一連串矩陣乘法與加法，只限制在有實際資料的輸入節點。

cues.en: Any implementation you'll find of this using tensorflow or keras just ignores that problem and models missing ratings as zeros.
cues.zh: 你找到的 TensorFlow 或 Keras 實作，都直接忽略問題，把缺失評分建模成零。

cues.en: You can still get decent results with enough effort, but it's a very fundamental problem to applying deep learning to recommender systems.
cues.zh: 努力後仍能有還不錯的結果，但這是深度學習用於推薦系統的根本問題。

cues.en: This architecture is referred to as an autoencoder.
cues.zh: 這個架構稱為自編碼器。

cues.en: The act of building up the weights and biases between the input and hidden layer is referred to as encoding the input.
cues.zh: 建立輸入與隱藏層之間權重、偏差，稱為編碼輸入。

cues.en: We are encoding the patterns in the input as a set of weights into that hidden layer.
cues.zh: 把輸入模式，編碼成進入隱藏層的權重集合。

cues.en: Then, as we reconstruct the output in the weights between the hidden and output layers, we are decoding it.
cues.zh: 再用隱藏與輸出層之間的權重重建輸出，稱為解碼。

cues.en: So, the first set of weights is the encoding stage, and the second set is the decoding stage.
cues.zh: 因此，第一組權重是編碼階段，第二組是解碼。

cues.en: Conceptually, this isn't really any different from what we were doing with RBMs.
cues.zh: 概念上，與 RBM 沒什麼不同。

cues.en: In an RBM, we encoded on the forward pass and decoded on the backward pass.
cues.zh: RBM 前向編碼，反向解碼。

cues.en: That problem hasn't stopped people from trying, however.
cues.zh: 不過，這個問題沒有阻止人們嘗試。

cues.en: A couple of ideas that I've seen used a few times are using deeper neural networks with more hidden layers, and one hot encoding the user and item data together into a single input layer.
cues.zh: 我看過幾次的想法，包括更多隱藏層的更深網路，以及將使用者與項目資料一起獨熱編碼，放進單一輸入層。

cues.en: That's what you see in this architecture printed out from keras.
cues.zh: 這就是 Keras 印出的架構。

cues.en: Items are embedded on the left side and users on the right.
cues.zh: 左邊嵌入項目，右邊嵌入使用者。

cues.en: Both are flattened and a dropout layer applied to prevent over-fitting, and then they are concatenated together, before feeding it all into a deep neural network.
cues.zh: 兩者攤平、套 Dropout 防過度擬合，再串接，全部送進深度神經網路。

cues.en: But it still has the problem of not being able to distinguish between missing ratings and ratings of a value zero.
cues.zh: 但仍無法區分缺失評分，與值為零的評分。

cues.en: Fundamentally, it models missing ratings as a signal that a user really, really hated to give an item, and that's just not an accurate representation of reality.
cues.zh: 基本上，把缺失評分，當成使用者非常討厭某項目的訊號，並不符合現實。

cues.en: In the end, this particular network was unable to outperform matrix factorization on the ML100K data set.
cues.zh: 最後，這個網路在 ML100K 資料集，無法勝過矩陣分解。

cues.en: In part, it's due to the sparsity of the data, and it's also because one hundred thousand ratings just isn't anywhere near enough data to train a network as complex as this.
cues.zh: 部分原因是稀疏，另一部分是十萬筆評分，遠不足以訓練這麼複雜的網路。

cues.en: When we talk later in this course about scaling things up to run in the cloud, we'll talk about Amazon's system, which is called DSSTNE, or Destiny for short.
cues.zh: 稍後談雲端擴展，會介紹 Amazon 系統 DSSTNE，唸作 Destiny。

cues.en: They actually have solved the problem of properly handling missing ratings, and their results are really good.
cues.zh: 它確實解決正確處理缺失評分的問題，結果很好。

cues.en: So, don't give up hope on deep neural networks for recommendations yet.
cues.zh: 因此，別對深度神經網路推薦放棄希望。

cues.en: They actually can work quite well once you have the right tools.
cues.zh: 有正確工具，就能運作得很好。

cues.en: It's not hard, however, to implement an autoencoder and tensorflow that just treats missing ratings as zero values, so let's give it a shot and see for ourselves how well it does.
cues.zh: 不過，用 TensorFlow 實作直接把缺失評分當零的自編碼器，不難，親自試試效果。
